label: Показать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for показать (to show).

missions.phrase: Я покажу тебе свои новые фотографии.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. Показать is perfective and has no present tense, so 'покажу' is the non-past 1sg form with future meaning. Note the stem mutation з becomes ж before the ending. The imperfective partner is показывать.

missions.phrase: Ты покажешь мне дорогу до центра?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Покажешь' shows the -ешь ending with the same ж mutation. As a perfective non-past it asks for one act of showing the way.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Покажет' is the он-form ending in -ет. The perfective marks a single completed showing, contrasting with the habitual показывает.

missions.phrase: Мы покажем гостям весь старый город.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Покажем' carries the -ем ending. The dative 'гостям' marks the people shown, and the perfective frames one finished tour.

missions.phrase: Вы покажете нам, как это работает?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Покажете' trains the respectful вы-form with the -ете ending. The perfective non-past asks for a single demonstration.

missions.phrase: Они покажут новый фильм в субботу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Покажут' closes the non-past ladder with the -ут ending. The perfective marks one future screening fixed to Saturday.

missions.phrase: Он показал мне дорогу к вокзалу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Показал' is the masculine singular past of perfective показать, built on the infinitive stem with -л. It reports one completed act of showing.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Показала' adds the feminine -а ending. The perfective past names a single finished presentation to the director in the dative.

missions.phrase: Ученики показали отличные результаты на экзамене.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Показали' is the plural past ending in -и, completing the past forms. 'Показать результаты' means to demonstrate results as one completed achievement.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Покажи' is the informal command form of perfective показать, asking for one act of showing. 'Пожалуйста' keeps the familiar request polite.
